description: My family has decided to invest in real state for the first time. Currently, they have $600,000 to invest, some in apartments and the rest in townhouses. The money invested in apartments must not be greater than $200,000. They have decided that the money invested in apartments must be at least a half as much as that in townhouses.  If the apartments earn 10%, and the townhouses earn 15%, how much money should they invest in each to maximize profit?

MaxInvestmentApartments.definition: Maximum amount that can be invested in apartments

MinInvestmentRatio.definition: Minimum ratio of investment in apartments to investment in townhouses

ReturnRateApartments.definition: Return on investment rate for apartments

ReturnRateTownhouses.definition: Return on investment rate for townhouses

objective.description: "Maximize the total profit earned from investments in apartments and townhouses."
objective.code:
model.setObjective(
    ReturnRateApartments * InvestmentApartments +
    ReturnRateTownhouses * InvestmentTownhouses,
    GRB.MAXIMIZE
)

constraints.description: The total amount invested in apartments and townhouses must equal 600000
The amount invested in apartments must not exceed 200000
The amount invested in apartments must be at least 0.5 times the amount invested in townhouses

InvestmentApartments.definition: Amount of money invested in apartments

InvestmentTownhouses.definition: Amount of money invested in townhouses
